description: Returns one company's EDGAR profile by ticker or CIK — name, exchange, industry (SIC), fiscal year end, entity type, and state of incorporation — plus whether standardized financials are loaded for it and, if so, how many facts and the latest reported period. Use after search_companies to confirm a company's identity and financials availability; use get_financials instead for the statements themselves. Read-only; no API key. Provide `ticker` or `cik`; if both are given, `cik` takes precedence. Any listed ticker for a company resolves to that company, not just its primary ticker.

cik.description: SEC CIK number, e.g. 1045810 (takes precedence over ticker)

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. 'NVDA' (any ticker the company lists)

name: get_company
